description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples used for microbial genome sequencing in agricultural farm plots with differing management practices.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record.

farm_id.descr: Identifier for the farm or agricultural site where the sample was collected.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the specific plot within the farm.

plot_treatment.descr: Agricultural management practice applied to the plot; examples include organic farming, conventional tillage, and no-till farming.

crop_type.descr: Primary crop grown in the plot at or before sampling; use standardized crop names where possible.

sample_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_time.descr: Local time of sample collection if available, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees, WGS84 coordinate system.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees, WGS84 coordinate system.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth of soil collected for sequencing, in centimeters below the surface.

soil_ph.descr: Measured soil pH at the time of sampling; report method if available in accompanying protocol.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content at sampling time, expressed as percent water content (%).

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius (°C).

replicate_id.descr: Replicate or subsample identifier within a plot and sampling event, if applicable.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect the soil sample, such as core, auger, or composite sampling.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Condition used to store the sample before DNA extraction; examples include frozen at -80 C, on ice, or refrigerated.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used for DNA extraction from soil.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation method used for sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, such as Illumina NovaSeq or Oxford Nanopore.

read_type.descr: Sequencing read type; examples include single-end, paired-end, or long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

genome_assembly_id.descr: Identifier for the assembled microbial genome or MAG associated with this sample, if applicable.

assembly_method.descr: Software or pipeline used for genome assembly, if applicable.

annotation_method.descr: Software or pipeline used for genome annotation, if applicable.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Primary taxonomic assignment for the recovered genome or dominant microbial community member, if available.

functional_profile_method.descr: Method used to infer functional potential, such as gene prediction, KEGG annotation, or eggNOG mapping.

quality_control_passed.descr: Indicates whether the sample or sequence record passed quality-control criteria.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on deviations, field observations, or other relevant context.
